scope: Characterization of installed MCP-client hosts. No runtime, registration, capability, scope, or Vault behavior is changed.

verificationPolicy.note: --check verifies schema, vocabulary, evidence references, tier/evidence-kind correspondence, static-scan digests over recorded marker counts (single-file or glob-collection scans), and checked-in JSON/Markdown drift. It does not re-scan host artifacts and does not verify external attestations.
verifiedByCheck: static marker counts are hashed and the digest is recomputed
checked-in JSON and Markdown match the authored data
notVerifiedByCheck: recorded marker counts still matching the currently installed host artifacts (re-run with --scan <scanId>=<path>; collection scans take the bundle directory)
runtime-session / command-output observations captured outside this repository
static excerpts that were read by hand from an installed artifact

evidenceTiers.runtime-observed: Observed directly while the host was running against an MCP surface in this task.
evidenceTiers.artifact-declared: Found in an installed host artifact (binary strings, bundled source, CLI output, shipped docs).
evidenceTiers.documentation-only: Claimed only by external documentation; no local implementation artifact found.
evidenceTiers.not-detected: Inspected the installed artifact and did not find the mechanism; absence is not proof of absence.
evidenceTiers.not-available: Host binary was not found locally; no capability claim is made.
evidenceTiers.unknown: Not measured and not resolvable from available evidence.

evidenceVerification.static-digest: Recorded marker counts are hashed; --check recomputes the digest. Re-deriving counts needs --scan against the artifact.
evidenceVerification.repository-test: Reproduced by the repository test suite (local in-process probe).
evidenceVerification.static-excerpt: Hand-read from an installed artifact; not machine-reproducible and not verified by --check.
evidenceVerification.external-attestation: Observed on the probe machine or in this session; not reproducible in CI and not verified by --check.

toolDiscoveryModes.real: A defer/tool-search mechanism exists in the installed host (artifact-declared or observed).
toolDiscoveryModes.documented-only: A mechanism is claimed only by external documentation.
toolDiscoveryModes.eager-fallback: Inspected host loads the full catalog and no defer/search path was found.
toolDiscoveryModes.unknown: Cannot be classified from available evidence.

schemaLoadModes.eager-auto: Host fetches and exposes full tool schemas (input/output) on connect.
schemaLoadModes.deferred-capable: Host has a mechanism to withhold or defer tool schemas, but the default is unverified.
schemaLoadModes.deferred-default: Host withholds tool schemas by default under an observed/declared configuration.

listRefreshModes.implemented: Host artifact contains a handler/refresh path for notifications/tools/list_changed.
listRefreshModes.declared-only: Only an SDK/schema declaration was found; no host refresh path.
listRefreshModes.not-detected: No handler and no schema for notifications/tools/list_changed was found.

crossSessionModes.re-discovered-per-session: Host reconnects and re-lists tools for a new process/session.
crossSessionModes.cached-across-sessions: Host persists a tool catalog across sessions.
